title: Senator asks US government watchdog to review how feds use hacking tools | TechCrunch
summary: Democratic senator Ron Wyden is asking the U.S. government to review how federal law enforcement agencies use hacking tools and spyware against Americans, citing a lack of transparency into how often or for what reasons these tools are deployed.
